Locally generated configuration-validation prose; not an approval or provider output.

semantic_scope: Workspace snapshot identity/stability, not review approval or certification of final state.

preferred_ja: メイン / サブエージェント / 両方
semantic_scope: Display-only placement labels; saved main, child, both values and role IDs unchanged.

english: cli; env; config; session; os; builtin
preferred_ja: コマンドライン / 環境変数 / 保存された設定 / セッション / OS / 組み込み
semantic_scope: Display-only source of a resolved language setting, not its actual value or storage key. task/project are only resolver sources where reachable.
Human display labels only; preserve stored enum values and status-based comparisons. Unknown values remain inspectable.
Dashboard count of nonterminal nonrunning work, not opening a view and not a failed item.

preferred_ja: ラベル設定 / 自動ラベル
semantic_scope: Session labeling policy; closing a screen is not deletion of saved labels.
Commands, options, data keys, paths, URLs, versions, hashes, diagnostic codes and internal sentinels. Never translate stored/comparison values.
Actual user/model/tool/provider content and saved editable definitions; only separately identified Jouzu-generated wrappers may be localized for future display.

preferred_ja: English / 日本語 / 简体中文 / 繁體中文
semantic_scope: Discoverable language names kept identical in all catalogs; does not add shipped interface languages.
Exact marker inserted for incomplete voice segments; not ordinary UI prose or a Japanese transcription.
Model/authentication service provider. Provider IDs and advertised provider/product names remain exact; do not collapse different providers or auth methods.
User message queued during an active streaming agent response. Not a follow-up held until the agent stops; one-at-a-time/all IDs remain unchanged.
Message queued until the agent stops; distinct from steering while streaming. Preserve dynamically resolved key and delivery-mode IDs.
Preferred provider request transport, not provider identity or authentication method; sse/websocket/websocket-cached/auto stay exact.

preferred_ja: HTTP アイドルタイムアウト
semantic_scope: Maximum inactive gap awaiting headers/body chunks, not total execution deadline. disabled maps to timeoutMs 0; do not infer that external work stopped.

preferred_ja: キャッシュの事前更新
semantic_scope: Provider prompt-cache maintenance while streaming and optionally between runs while economically worthwhile; not model warming or an assurance of free requests. off/streaming/idle mode IDs stay exact. Wording is a proposal for central terminology review.
avoid: 無料のキャッシュ更新

semantic_scope: A prompt-cache miss and associated cost/recovery notices; not missing source files or deleted cache data.
Decision governing trust in project resources. Default applies only if no extension or saved decision decides; ask/always/never IDs remain exact and never-trust negation must survive.
Terminal alternate-screen layout, distinct from regular scrollback layout. Translate prose only; fullscreen/regular and setting values remain exact.
Horizontal display spacing for editor/messages/output; does not modify file contents or message text. Preserve allowed numeric ranges.
Provider account/subscription authentication distinct from API keys and non-subscription accounts. Paid extra usage warning retains possible extra-charge risk; it is not a billing toggle.

preferred_ja: プレビュー上だけの警告 / 警告
semantic_scope: Display-only risk notice in code previews; neither blocks execution nor certifies safety. Possible secret matches remain possibilities, not confirmed leaks; distinguish this from actual tool/source errors.
avoid: ブロック済み; 安全を確認済み

preferred_ja: テーマ / ライト表示・ダーク表示
semantic_scope: Color theme and terminal appearance. Pi selection previews can be canceled; code-preview theme selection saves on Enter without movement preview. Theme IDs remain unchanged.
OAuth code exchanged for access/refresh tokens, not a device userCode, API key, or provider sign-in password. Anthropic copy-code and OpenAI callback flows remain distinct from device-code polling.
avoid: 認証コードへの一律置換

semantic_scope: Headless/other-device sign-in with displayed user code and provider polling; distinct from pasted authorization-code/redirect-URL flows. Displayed code and URLs remain exact.
avoid: 認可コードとの同一視

preferred_ja: AWS 資格情報チェーン
semantic_scope: Existing AWS SDK credential resolution chain, distinct from saved bearer token or saved profile name. Ambient credentials are not automatically copied into Pi storage.

preferred_ja: アプリケーションのデフォルト認証情報
semantic_scope: Named Google Cloud authentication method. Proposal intentionally uses the service-specific Japanese method name rather than shared default=既定 and credential=資格情報; generic credential prose still uses 資格情報. Requires central terminology reconciliation, not a glossary-policy change.
avoid: 単なる既定の API キー

preferred_ja: セッションツリー / 分岐
semantic_scope: Tree of session entries and conversation branches, or threaded session-parent list as context specifies. Not a Git branch. Label removal removes a label only; branch navigation is not deletion.

Optional summary when navigating session branches. Distinguish choice cancellation, summary abortion, and navigation cancellation. Model-generated summary and user instructions are content, not translated UI.

preferred_ja: 折りたたみ時 / 展開した / 非表示の行
semantic_scope: Preview display states, not output destruction or tool cancellation. Expansion may show more retained output but cannot recover output already truncated by the tool. Counts/nouns require a Japanese formatter instead of English suffix pluralization.
Shiki coloring of retained code/output. A skip notice for large data does not mean read/write/edit failed or content is missing. Language/theme IDs and actual code remain unchanged.

english: diff; proposed edit; applied edit; hunk
preferred_ja: 差分 / 編集案 / 適用した編集 / 差分ブロック
semantic_scope: Preview of proposed or actual changes; keep proposed and applied distinct. Hunk is a contiguous changed group, not a file. Skipping diff rendering does not mean skipping the file mutation; underlying diff text remains exact.

preferred_ja: 経過時間 / 所要時間
semantic_scope: Running elapsed duration versus fixed final duration of tool execution. Completion timing is not a success assertion. Technical duration units and value formatting stay unchanged.

preferred_ja: 設定 / 設定ファイル
semantic_scope: Generic configuration data/file is translated even when English source begins with capital Settings. Only the named Jouzu Palette view Settings is protected.

preferred_ja: フローの予約 / 進まなくなった予約
semantic_scope: Provider-request admission reservation. Releasing it leaves receipt evidence, waits, and running jobs unchanged; not a scheduled prompt or job deletion.
Flow-managed lineage of automated work. Pause holds its future automated turns; stop retires the work and ends its waits, without stopping a running job. Keep work IDs unchanged.

preferred_ja: セッションに紐付け / セッション紐付け
semantic_scope: A scheduled job associated with the current session so only its owning Pi fires it. Shared jobs are distinct; toggling the default affects newly created jobs, not existing bindings.
avoid: セッションに保存すれば必ず実行

preferred_ja: 自動進行 / 自動モード
semantic_scope: Task-list automation that queues follow-up prompts for eligible tasks. Turning it off does not complete tasks or terminate shell processes. Exact off/cascade/auto setting values remain unchanged.
Background-process output or completion notification that can wake the agent. Not a process restart, automatic rerun, or guarantee of successful delivery; retain notification IDs and receipt data.

Expiry of a local operation or observed deadline. Cancellation/termination effects depend on the caller. A timeout alone does not establish the outcome of remote work; retain refresh-before-retry and evidence-preservation instructions.
avoid: タイムアウトしたので未送信

preferred_ja: ループ / レーン / 実行タグ
semantic_scope: Multiloop automation and its state identity. Display nouns may translate; lane/run-tag, saved identifiers, mode/status values, commands, and state paths do not. Stopping a loop is not stopping a shell process.
avoid: ループ停止でジョブも停止

semantic_scope: Quick-goal objective and run, not a metric threshold by implication. Complete means objective achieved under the completion policy; pause/stop/clear do not imply running jobs were killed. User-provided objective text stays unchanged.

preferred_ja: 反復 / ステップ / 採用 / 差し戻し
semantic_scope: Recorded measured-loop iterations versus quick-goal recorded steps. Keep/revert describe acceptance of an iteration, not whether the whole objective is complete. Cumulative tokens/turns are usage accounting, not active context occupancy.
avoid: 採用されたので目標達成

preferred_ja: アーカイブ / アーカイブ済み
semantic_scope: Move multiloop state to its archive and hide it from default lists. State/history remain; rm deletes state files and is a different action. Preserve .multiloop paths and exact run identifiers.
